messages:
samir: quick RFC follow-up — i built an edge "soft-shed" filter to dampen short probe/scrape bursts before they hit central quotas. want feedback on interfaces and rollout plan.

maria: thanks. what's the core signal? small payload + high rps? repeated endpoints?

samir: both. main detect: rapid small requests to many endpoints + low response entropy. filter returns an advisory hint to proxy: score + backoff suggestions + optional server-signed fingerprint.

aaron: prefer advisory (non-binding) so core limiter stays authoritative. avoids coupling and lets us roll back safely.

jyoti: perf note: keep per-node state tiny (<64k entries), no cross-node sync on hot path. async replicate only heavy hitters.
maria: add confidence and reason fields to the hint so alerts can be actionable. also TTL on fingerprints for privacy.
samir: sample hint: score 0..1, backoff_ms [50,200], confidence, reason, fingerprint:sha256, ttl_s.
aaron: make backoff an array for exponential steps and include reversible=true if state can be cleared later.
jyoti: rollout: canary 1% for 24h, watch attn_score_p95, p95 latency, and fingerprint-churn. add kill-switch per-region.
maria: tests: unit hint parsing, perf harness (<2ms p50), synthetic replay to measure FP <0.5%. privacy: store only hashes, rotate signing keys quarterly.
samir: action items: maria update proto w/ confidence & privacy notes (EOD). aaron propose memory budget for LRU (tomorrow). jyoti create dashboards and rollback doc. i'll open follow-up PR and schedule canary.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled 2025-03-04T10:00:00Z region=us-west-2 pct=1
samir: thanks. :thumbsup:
aaron: +1
maria: +1
jyoti: prepping monitors
